reason: Free NotebookLM, ChatGPT, Knowt, and our campus Zalo and Google Drive exam banks already cost $0, so on a $3,000/year student budget I'm not paying $2.67 (69,000 VND) for a 7-day pass in a normal week. At most I'd test the 10 free starter questions or join a classmate's free /arena room.
objection: NotebookLM already links answers back to my uploaded PDFs for free, and seniors' Drive folders have actual past exam questions from our lecturers, so I doubt a 7-day AI pass over lecture slides justifies spending 69,000 VND.
would_change_my_mind: Only if I were cramming 48 hours before a tough quantitative final where our campus Drive banks lacked worked solutions, and the free starter deck proved its formula-remix drills were noticeably better than NotebookLM and ChatGPT.
